description: The year selector shows the United States national flag in force on July 4 of that year. Star additions take effect after state admission, rather than on the admission date. Before 1912 the drawings use representative arrangements and proportions; the 1912, 1959, and 1960 layouts follow the standardized designs. These are newly drawn illustrations, not archival flag photographs.

versions.label: 15 stars · 15 stripes
versions.description: 15 stars · 15 stripes. Representative row arrangement; early star layouts and proportions varied. This is an illustration of the official star and stripe count, not a replica of one surviving flag. The 15-star and 15-stripe design remained official until 1818, even as additional states entered the Union.
